channel.title: Morning Brief — Australia Edition
channel.description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — no technology or AI news. Made to listen to on the morning drive.
channel.itunes:author: Morning Brief

item.title: Morning Brief — Sunday, 13 September 2026
item.description: Today: a looming lift on the plug-in solar ban, South Australia's aged-care bed-block costs, Queensland's weekend bushfire outbreak and a $1 million cold-case reward, and a Coomera townhouse fire on the Gold Coast. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (호주, 퀸즐랜드, 그리고 골드코스트 소식만 담았습니다. 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).
